text: Yeah, I do have a couple of things. I placed a laptop order, and I need to change the address it's going to, but I can't really give you the new one right now, it's in my profile though. And I also want to change the specs on the laptop itself – I want it to have an i5 processor, 256GB SSD storage, and the space grey color. Also, I have a watch I want to exchange. It's the same model, but I want a black dial, but I want to keep the leather strap. So yeah, those are the main things I need to sort out.
zh: 是的，我确实有几个问题。我下了一个笔记本电脑订单，我需要更改它要寄送的地址，但我现在不能真的给您新的地址，它在我的资料中。我也想更改笔记本电脑本身的规格——我想让它有i5处理器、256GB SSD存储和太空灰颜色。另外，我有一块手表我想换货。是同一个型号，但我想换成黑色表盘，但我想保留皮革表带。所以是的，这些都是我需要处理的主要问题。
